thought.text: `claimToken` dikirim sebagai parameter, jadi berasal dari luar. Saya cari di bundle lazy-loaded `claim-hbvxUq5Q.js`.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 60 "https://dash.allmodels.io/assets/claim-hbvxUq5Q.js" -o /tmp/claim.js -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"; python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/claim.js',errors='ignore').read()
for kw in ['claimToken','searchParams','recaptcha','6L']:
    for m in list(re.finditer(kw,s))[:3]:
        print(f"[{kw}] {re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-300):m.start()+300])}\n")
    print('-'*60)
PY
